text.en:
While Airborne, pressing [Air Move] performs a horizonal dash that propels you 8 meters towards the input direction before entering a 4 second cooldown.

While <solar/>Heat Rises or <solar/>Song of Flame is active, gain an additional charge of Icarus Dash before entering a 5 second cooldown (currently only works in <solar/>Song of Flame while using <solar/>Incinerator Snap). Both charges are refilled per cooldown period.

Icarus Dash can be used infinitely during <solar/>Daybreak at the cost of 4.2% super energy per use.

While Airborne, Weapon or Super Kills within 5 seconds of each grants <solar/>Cure x1. Activation Progress is based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minor: 34%
• Elite: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 67%
